dev_notes: MET values from the 2024 Adult Compendium of Physical Activities (Herrmann et al., 2024), read from its tracking guide. Each activity keeps its 2024 code and description, so it can be checked. The app shows only name and group. kcal = (MET - 1) x body kg x hours: net of resting, like Apple Health active energy.

source.title: 2024 Adult Compendium of Physical Activities
source.citation: Herrmann SD, Willis EA, Ainsworth BE, et al. 2024 Adult Compendium of Physical Activities: A third update of the energy costs of human activities. Journal of Sport and Health Science 2024;13(1):6-12. doi:10.1016/j.jshs.2023.10.010

activities.name: Walk, moderate pace
activities.compendium: Walking, 2.8 to 3.4 mph, level, moderate pace, firm surface

activities.name: Walk, brisk
activities.compendium: Walking, 3.5 to 3.9 mph, level, brisk, firm surface, walking for exercise

activities.name: Walk, very brisk
activities.compendium: Walking, 4.0 to 4.4 mph (6.4 to 7.0 km/h), level, firm surface, very brisk pace

activities.name: Weights, general
activities.compendium: Resistance (weight) training, multiple exercises, 8-15 reps at varied resistance

activities.name: Weights, heavy
activities.compendium: Resistance (weight lifting - free weight, nautilus or universal-type), power lifting or body building, vigorous effort

activities.name: Circuit training, hard
activities.compendium: Circuit training, including kettlebells, some aerobic movement with minimal rest, general, vigorous intensity

activities.name: HIIT, moderate
activities.compendium: High intensity interval exercise, moderate effort

activities.name: HIIT, hard
activities.compendium: High intensity interval exercise, burpees, mountain climbers, squat jumps, Tabata, vigorous effort

activities.name: Rowing machine, moderate
activities.compendium: Rowing, stationary ergometer, general, <100 watts, moderate effort

activities.name: Rowing machine, hard
activities.compendium: Rowing, stationary ergometer, general, vigorous effort

activities.name: Calisthenics, hard
activities.compendium: Calisthenics (e.g., pushups, sit ups, pull-ups, jumping jacks, burpees, battling ropes), vigorous effort

activities.name: Badminton
activities.compendium: Badminton, social singles and doubles, general

activities.name: Martial arts
activities.compendium: Martial Arts, different types, moderate pace (e.g., judo, jujitsu, karate, kick boxing, tae kwon do, tai-bo, Muay Thai boxing)

activities.name: Skipping rope
activities.compendium: Rope jumping, moderate pace, general, 100 to 120 skips/min, 2 foot skip, plain bounce

activities.name: Dancing
activities.compendium: Ethnic or cultural dancing (e.g. Greek, Middle Eastern, hula, salsa, merengue, bamba y plena, flamenco, belly, and swing)

activities.name: Swim, fast lengths
activities.compendium: Swimming laps, freestyle, fast, vigorous effort

activities.name: Swim, leisurely
activities.compendium: Swimming, leisurely, not lap swimming, general
